How to read this dashboard

Definitions and data handling, so every number can be traced back to the master file
Billing status
The master file has no populated Active columns, so a shop counts as billing in a year when its purchase total for that year is above zero. Change the year filter and every card follows it.
FY 2026-27
Only Apr–Jul 2026 exists in the file, so year-on-year comparisons use the matching Apr–Jul 2025 window rather than full-year totals.
